name: 微信公众号五机分布式部署包

scope: existing MySQL corpus before each import
deduplication.articleNaturalKey: platform + articleId; canonical URL when articleId is empty
deduplication.bodyRule: exact normalized body or bidirectional 5-character shingle similarity >= 0.80
deduplication.shortBodyRule: under 5 normalized characters only exact equality can match
deduplication.mergeRule: maximum engagement counts, fill empty fields, retain richer content/media, force article image info null

logging.scope: one independent log directory per worker

wechatUiCompatibility.articleTabGuard: verify RootWebArea title is keyword - 文章 - 搜一搜; abort rather than collect 全部/视频

pagination.zeroMeans: unlimited until confirmed exhaustion or operator safe stop
pagination.cutoffBehavior: require 最新 sort; stop the current keyword at the first dated result before 2026-01-01
pagination.topVerification: require RootWebArea vertical scroll percent 0.0 before interpreting index 0
pagination.partialResume: restart from newest index 0 and idempotently upsert known URLs so inserted new articles cannot shift a numeric checkpoint
